replacements.reason: Expose the native UCF 0.84 DBOOC helper to the source SquatRv callback at the original 0x800D65EC threshold-load injection point.

Translate the pinned UCF 0.84 DBOOC SquatRv Fix hook at GALE01 address 0x800D65EC. The predicate retains the exact fresh X-tilt (unsigned x670 byte < 1) and adjusted-radial (sum of squares strictly greater than 80*80) boundaries, then relaxes the crouch-release threshold from p_ftCommonData->x94 to binary32 0.59 (payload word 0x3F170A3D). The shared CheckInput carries the fix to every SquatWait, Squat, and landing caller.
